changelog: Merged the four critic candidate rules into [Priority Rules] as surface-decidable 'safety demotions' that lower confidence (do not ban) for: very-short left NPs ending in a title/name/pronoun, single pronoun/auxiliary left pieces before a lexical verb, verb-before-PP cuts, and ethnonym/demonym cuts before comma-appositives or locative PPs within ~4 tokens; this expresses all four ideas concisely and as ranking guidance rather than prohibitions.
